title: Japanese Melon Salad
description: A refreshing Japanese-inspired salad made with fresh melon and a hint of sweet and sour flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced melon and torn salad.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until dissolved.
Pour the dressing over the melon and salad, and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds and pickled ginger over the top of the salad, and toss again to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional sesame seeds and pickled ginger if desired.
